english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial way to refer to someone who plays or mixes recorded music.

examples.english: Ming is the disc jockey at the bar, and he keeps the customers dancing all night.
examples.traditional: 阿明喺酒吧打碟嘅，成晚都搞到啲客跳舞跳個不停。
